_doc: Optimal mobile GPU config via OpenCL (Adreno / Mali / PowerVR).
WHY these flags:
backend_type: opencl — Runs all MatMul, attention, and MLP ops on the GPU.
gpu_mode flags become MNN's thread_num directly (no separate threads field for GPU).
gpu_mode flags (bitwise-ORed by the C++ binary):
MNN_GPU_MEMORY_BUFFER (1<<6 = 64)
— Uses OpenCL buffer objects instead of image2d. Buffers support arbitrary
shapes without texture size limits and allow zero-copy between ops when
the driver supports SVM or fine-grained shared virtual memory.
MNN_GPU_TUNING_WIDE (1<<2 = 4)
— On first run, benchmarks a wide set of local-workgroup-size candidates
per kernel and caches the winners to mnn_cachefile.bin. Subsequent runs
skip tuning and replay the optimal dispatch parameters.
MNN_GPU_RECORD_BATCH (1<<9 = 512)
— Records 10 consecutive kernels into a single OpenCL command-buffer
recording (clEnqueueNDRangeKernel batching). On Qualcomm Adreno this
reduces per-dispatch CPU overhead by ~5-8× via the CL recording extension.
precision: low       — FP16 compute on GPU. Modern mobile GPUs have 2× FP16
throughput vs FP32 (Adreno 730+: 2 TFLOPS FP16).
memory: low          — Compact GPU buffer allocation; frees intermediate
buffers as soon as possible to stay within GPU VRAM.
power: high          — Hints the GPU driver to use maximum clock frequency.
quant_qkv: 11        — KV cache: K=INT8 + V=FP8 + flash attention (3|8).
The quantised KV cache lives in GPU memory, saving VRAM.
use_mmap: true       — Memory-maps weights on the CPU side before upload to GPU;
avoids double-buffering during model load.
OP_ENCODER_NUMBER_FOR_COMMIT: 10
— Batches 10 ops into a single GPU command-buffer submission (encoder commit).
Reduces clFlush / vkQueueSubmit overhead. The optimal value is 6-15;
10 balances latency and throughput for typical LLM decoder layers.
QKV_QUANT_OPTIONS: 11  — Mirrors quant_qkv; applied via RuntimeManager hint.
